meta.description: Comprehensive governance mapping from CMA Part 1 to CMA Part 2. Every governance rule, standard section, protocol, and defect class from Part 1 is classified as Carry Forward, Modify, Retire, or Add for Part 2.

A_governance_guard_rules.name: question_state → REVISION_HISTORY.md pairing
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: The pairing requirement is universal, but the file paths change: P2 uses knowledge/REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md and pack_p2_*.js files. The SOURCE_FILE_RE regex must be updated to match P2 pack filenames.
A_governance_guard_rules.part2_adaptation: Update SOURCE_FILE_RE to match pack_p2_[a-e].js and case_pack_p2_[1-3].js. Update REVISION_HISTORY path to knowledge/REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md. Core enforcement logic unchanged.

A_governance_guard_rules.name: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] must be empty (DL-008 enforcement)
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: Universal structural rule. The EV8 requirement — that the ExplanationWrong slot matching CorrectChoice must be empty — applies identically to P2 items. The single-object architecture eliminates the DL-016/CC-offset false-positive risk, but the rule itself is unchanged.

A_governance_guard_rules.name: MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md is generated, never hand-edited
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: The registry-is-derived principle is universal, but the P2 registry filename and regeneration script path differ. P2 uses MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY_P2.md generated by scripts/build_master_registry_p2.js.
A_governance_guard_rules.part2_adaptation: Update basename check from MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md to MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY_P2.md. Update error message to reference P2-specific regeneration script.

A_governance_guard_rules.name: Answer-key changes must include recomputed/independently verified note
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: Universal answer-key governance. Every CorrectChoice or Correct change in any MCQ bank must include a verification note. Applies identically to P2 items.

A_governance_guard_rules.name: ≤30 question objects per change-set without BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: Universal process control. The 30-item batch cap prevents large-scale unreviewed changes. The BLOCK-AUTHORIZED exception mechanism is equally appropriate for P2 batch operations.

A_governance_guard_rules.name: Non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots must be non-empty (DL-026 enforcement)
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: Universal educational quality rule. Every distractor ExplanationWrong slot must contain choice-specific explanatory text. The single-object architecture makes detection simpler but the rule is unchanged.

A_governance_guard_rules.name: DERIVED_REGISTRY_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE — no hand-editing derived registries
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: The no-hand-editing principle is universal, but the list of derived registry paths must be updated for P2. P2 has its own CURRENT_BASELINES_P2.md, SESSION_STATUS files, and DEFECT_MANIFEST files.
A_governance_guard_rules.part2_adaptation: Update DERIVED_REGISTRY_RE to match P2 filenames: CURRENT_BASELINES_P2.md, MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY_P2.md, DEFECT_MANIFEST_DL008_DL026_P2.json. Add P2-specific SESSION_STATUS pattern. REGENERATION_SCRIPT_RE unchanged (covers all rebuild/regenerate scripts).

A_governance_guard_rules.name: UNTRACKED_ARTIFACT — session packages must be registered
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: Universal artifact tracking. The session_registry.json mechanism is identical in concept. P2 may use a shared or separate registry — the rule stays the same.
A_governance_guard_rules.part2_adaptation: SESSION_PACKAGES_RE path may change if P2 uses a different output directory. If P2 has its own repo, the path is structurally identical (scripts/output/session_packages/). If co-located, requires P2-specific subdirectory.

A_governance_guard_rules.name: Choice binary lead-in polarity mismatch (DL-037 enforcement)
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: Universal content quality rule. The "No + affirmative conclusion" and "Yes + negative conclusion" patterns are language-level defects that apply identically to P2 choices.

A_governance_guard_rules.name: Non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong fields must be present and non-empty (DL-021 enforcement)
A_governance_guard_rules.rationale: Universal structural rule. Every P2 item must have all four ExplanationWrong fields present, with the CorrectChoice slot empty and the three distractor slots populated.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Governance Guard Plugin — Registered, Do Not Re-Litigate
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: The plugin registration principle carries forward, but the specific numbers change: P2 plugin has 10 rules (same count), different file counts, different pack names. The table of rules must reference P2 filenames.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Update table to reference pack_p2_*.js, case_pack_p2_*.js. Update governance guard file path to .opencode/plugins/governance-guard.js (same path, forked content). Test suite path: scripts/test_governance_guard_p2.js.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Read-Only by Default
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: Universal safety principle. All exploratory and audit tasks default to read-only. Explicit authorization required before any write. This principle is independent of exam part content.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Backup Protocol — Mandatory Before Every File Edit
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: The backup rule itself is universal, but the list of protected files changes. P2 pack files are pack_p2_a.js through pack_p2_e.js and case_pack_p2_1.js through case_pack_p2_3.js.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Update file pattern from pack_[a-e]_corrected.js to pack_p2_[a-e].js. Add case_pack_p2_[1-3].js. Backup naming convention: pack_p2_X.js.bak-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. Core protocol (copy → confirm → edit) unchanged.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Destructive Script Execution — Staged Authorization Required
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: Universal safety rule. No file deletion without explicit staged authorization, backup, and verification. Precedent and reasoning are independent of exam part content.

B_agents_md_sections.name: REVISION_HISTORY.md — Required for Every Certification or Content Change
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: The revision-history pairing requirement is universal, but P2 uses knowledge/REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md. All P2 question_state changes and content changes must log to this file.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Update file path to knowledge/REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md. Core requirements (contemporaneous entries, before/after counts, QuestionID lists) unchanged.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Dual Verification — Cross-Check All Self-Reported Claims
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: Universal auditing principle. Every self-reported claim must be cross-checked against raw file/line evidence. The verification methods (grep, file inspection) are identical. P2-specific changes are to the claim-to-check mapping table only.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Update the claim cross-check table: change "Certification complete" check from pack_*_corrected.js to pack_p2_*.js. Update QID patterns from P1- to P2-.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Item-Count Volatility — Hard Stop
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: Universal counting discipline. Count instability must be resolved before any remediation proceeds. This principle is content-independent.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Live-Simulation Delivery Pool — Certified-Only + Known-Defective Exclusion
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: The delivery-pool filtering principle is universal, but P2 has its own QID spaces, defect lists, and pool definitions. P2 delivery must filter by question_state === "Certified" on P2- QIDs and exclude P2 known-defective items.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Update QID prefix from P1- to P2-. Update defect cross-reference from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md to DEFECT_LIBRARY_P2.md. Update known-defective QID list. Update pool file references to pack_p2_*.js.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Key File Locations — Pinned Reference
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: Every path in the pinned reference table must be updated for P2. The table structure is identical; only the filenames change.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Replace entire table with P2 equivalents: governance-guard.js (same path, forked), test_governance_guard_p2.js, REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md, BACKUP_PROTOCOL.md (unchanged), CAQS_P2_v1.0.md, DEFECT_LIBRARY_P2.md, SESSION_STATUS_P2_*.md, CURRENT_BASELINES_P2.md. Add P2-specific entries: FORMULA_MASTER_P2.md, EXAM_BLUEPRINT_P2.md.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Session Startup Protocol
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: The T0 verification checks (hash verification, registry staleness, cross-registry reconciliation) all apply to P2 but with P2-specific files and baselines. The methodology — direct grep, raw file authority — is unchanged.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Update all file references: pack_p2_*.js for Certified count grep, CURRENT_BASELINES_P2.md for hash verification, MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY_P2.md for registry staleness. Update §5 governance-critical hash table entries. Add P2-specific T0 check: Part2OnlyFlag presence verification.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Skills
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: The two Part 1 skills (reconciliation-audit, pre-delivery-safety-check) have P2 equivalents. The reconciliation-audit skill checks P2 certification claims against raw P2 files. The pre-delivery-safety-check validates P2 delivery pools.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Create P2-specific skill files: .opencode/skills/reconciliation-audit-p2.md and .opencode/skills/pre-delivery-safety-check-p2.md. Core verification logic identical; target files differ.

B_agents_md_sections.name: External References
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: The IMA CMA Exam Content Specification Outline reference carries forward (Part 2 version). The OpenCode plugin documentation reference is unchanged. P2 adds authoritative sources: COSO ERM 2017, CAPM theory, IMA Ethics, SOX, FCPA.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Update CSO reference to IMA CMA Part 2 Content Specification Outline. Add P2-specific authorities: COSO ERM 2017, FASB ASC (ratio standards), CAPM (Sharpe-Lintner), IMA SMA on relevant costing, IMA Statement of Ethical Professional Practice, SOX 2002, FCPA.

B_agents_md_sections.name: No Staged Findings — Log Before Session Close
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: Universal process discipline. Every defect finding must be logged to DEFECT_LIBRARY_P2.md and/or REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md before session close. The principle and consequences (DL-019, DL-020 precedent) are content-independent.

B_agents_md_sections.name: Runtime Governance — Multi-Agent and Long-Lived Sessions
B_agents_md_sections.rationale: The T0→Tmid→Tend checkpoint sequence is universal, but P2 has its own baseline files, session reports, and structural defect IDs. The drift-detection signals are universal; the response paths reference P2-specific files.
B_agents_md_sections.part2_adaptation: Update baseline hash table to P2 files (pack_p2_*.js, case_pack_p2_*.js, app.js fork). Update CAPA references to P2-specific defect IDs. Update session report references to P2 directory. Core checkpoint logic and drift signals unchanged.

C_caqs_sections.name: Purpose, Scope, Alignment Requirements, AI Philosophy
C_caqs_sections.rationale: Section structure carries forward but content must reflect Part 2. §1.3 alignment requirements reference Part 2 CSO and Part 2 authorities (COSO ERM 2017, IMA Ethics, CAPM). §1.4 builds on Part 1's temporal separation but adapted for P2.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: §1.3: Update to IMA CMA Part 2 CSO. Replace COSO IC (2013) with COSO ERM (2017) as primary framework. Add CAPM theory, IMA Ethics, SOX, FCPA as alignment authorities. §1.4: Preserve temporal AI philosophy (build-time vs runtime).

C_caqs_sections.name: Build-Time AI Verification Standard (6 dimensions)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The six-dimension verification framework is universal, but Dimension 6 (relevance check) changes from 'CMA Part 1 Relevance' to 'CMA Part 2 Relevance.' The Part 2 dimension excludes Part 1-only topics (cost management detail, internal controls IC framework) and ensures no Part 1 concept leakage.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: Dimension 6 renamed from 'CMA Part 1 Relevance' to 'CMA Part 2 Relevance.' Verification criteria: (a) topic is in Part 2 CSO, (b) no Part 1-only content (e.g., detailed cost allocation methods, IC monitoring activities), (c) Part2OnlyFlag is present. Add authority dimension check: cited authority matches Part 2 domain.

C_caqs_sections.name: Certification Standard (state governance, requirements, correctness priority)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The five governance states (Unprocessed, In Audit, Editorial Queue, Certified, Archived) are universal. The HIGH-confidence gate and correctness-over-throughput principle apply identically to P2.

C_caqs_sections.name: Definition of 'Exam-Ready'
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The three exam-ready criteria (Gold Standard Checklist, minimum 90/100 quality score, zero validation errors) apply identically to P2 content.

C_caqs_sections.name: Question Quality Rubric (100 points, 10 dimensions)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The 10-dimension weighted rubric (Blueprint Alignment 20%, Cognitive Level 15%, Technical Accuracy 15%, Distractor Quality 15%, Business Realism 10%, Numerical Integrity 10%, Explanation Quality 10%, Writing Clarity 5%, Accessibility 5%, Metadata Completeness 5%) is universal. Auto-fail conditions (Dimension 3 or 6 = 0) carry forward.

C_caqs_sections.name: Case Study Standards (3.1–3.8)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: All case study standards — scenario requirements, language, question interconnection, exhibit standards, cognitive progression, blueprint traceability, realism, anti-AI writing — apply identically to P2 cases.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: §3.6 Blueprint Traceability Matrix: update domain names from A-F (P1) to A-F (P2). §3.8 Anti-AI Writing Standards: carry forward unchanged. P2 adds Domain D (Risk Management) exhibit types from P2001 §3.

C_caqs_sections.name: Explanation Standards (4.1–4.4, EV1–EV8)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: All explanation requirements — required elements, templates, language rules, validation rules EV1 through EV8 — apply identically to P2. The EV8 rule (ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] must be empty) is universal.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: §4.1 Required Elements: update standard references to P2 authorities (COSO ERM 2017 instead of COSO IC, CAPM, IMA Ethics). §4.2 Templates: use P2-specific example authorities. §4.3 Language Rules: unchanged.

C_caqs_sections.name: Numerical Validation Standard (5.1–5.5)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: All numerical validation rules — independent recalculation, rounding policy, accepted tolerances, formula verification checklist, financial statement impact verification — are universal. P2 has more formulas (40+ vs P1's ~30) but the validation methodology is identical.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: §5.2 Rounding Policy: add P2-specific contexts (bond prices to 3 decimal places, WACC to 2 decimal places, NPV to nearest dollar, betas to 2 decimal places). §5.4 Formula Verification Checklist: extend to P2 formula verification (see Category G).

C_caqs_sections.name: Psychometric Standards (6.1–6.6)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The psychometric framework carries forward, but target distributions differ by domain for P2. P1 used uniform targets across all domains; P2 has per-domain Bloom's and difficulty targets specified in P2001.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: §6.1 Target Difficulty Distribution: carry forward same targets (Easy 15%, Mod-Easy 20%, Mod 30%, Difficult 25%, Very Difficult 10%). §6.2 Bloom's Taxonomy Distribution: update from P1 uniform targets to P2 per-domain targets (Domain D has 20% Remember vs Domain E at 10%). §6.3-6.6: carry forward unchanged.

C_caqs_sections.name: Metadata Standard
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The metadata framework carries forward, but P2 adds Part2OnlyFlag (boolean, mandatory), uses P2 domain enums (A=Financial Statement Analysis, B=Corporate Finance, C=Decision Analysis, D=Risk Management, E=Investment Decisions, F=Professional Ethics), and uses P2 QID/CaseID formats.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: Add Part2OnlyFlag field (boolean, default true, required). Update all domain enum values to P2 domains. Update QID pattern to P2-{Section}-{NNN}. Update CaseID pattern to CBQ2{Pack}-{Section}{Seq}. Update formula references to FORMULA_MASTER_P2.md. Update authority references to P2 authorities.

C_caqs_sections.name: Acceptance Criteria (Quality Gates G1–G7)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The seven-gate acceptance pipeline (G1 Technical Review through G7 Approval) carries forward identically. Each gate's minimum score and checking role are content-independent.

C_caqs_sections.name: Audit Workflow (9.1–9.5)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The seven-step audit pipeline (Technical Review → Psychometric → Numerical → Instructional → Metadata → Final Validation → Approval) carries forward identically. Batch organization changes to P2 domains but the workflow is identical.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: §9.2 Batch Review Process: update batch list to P2 domains (A=Financial Statement Analysis, B=Corporate Finance, C=Decision Analysis, D=Risk Management, E=Investment Decisions, F=Professional Ethics).

C_caqs_sections.name: Learning Science Standards
C_caqs_sections.rationale: All learning science elements (retrieval practice, error correction, worked examples, transfer learning, spacing readiness, interleaving readiness) and the Explanation as Mini-Lesson structure are content-independent.

C_caqs_sections.name: Accessibility Standards
C_caqs_sections.rationale: All accessibility requirements (color-independent, screen reader, keyboard, responsive scaling, language clarity, alternative formats) are content-independent.

C_caqs_sections.name: Gold Standard Checklist
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The checklist structure carries forward, but authority references, blueprint domains, and formula sources must be updated for Part 2. P2 adds several checklist items specific to Part 2 authorities.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: Update all checklist items referencing P1 authorities: 'COSO IC (2013)' → 'COSO ERM (2017),' 'ASC xxx' → P2-relevant ASC references (ASC 260, ASC 470, ASC 820), add Part2OnlyFlag verification item, add CAPM/IMA Ethics authority verification item, update formula reference to FORMULA_MASTER_P2.md.

C_caqs_sections.name: Continuous Improvement (Quality Trend Tracking, Standard Updates, Exception Process)
C_caqs_sections.rationale: The continuous improvement framework carries forward, but P2 starts with its own baseline metrics (0% reviewed, 0% certified at Day 0). P2 target is 95%+ certification (~2,375/2,500).
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: Update baseline metrics: Repository Health Score starts at 0 (not 42), Gold Standard Content at 0%, Content Reviewed at 0%. Set P2 targets: ≥95% certified, ≥90/100 mean rubric score, zero validation errors. Track against P2-specific blueprint coverage targets.

C_caqs_sections.name: NEW: Authority Verification Dimension
C_caqs_sections.rationale: Part 2 has significantly more diverse authorities than Part 1 (COSO ERM 2017, CAPM, IMA Ethics, SOX, FCPA, Modigliani-Miller, Basel III, MACRS). A seventh verification dimension dedicated to authority citation correctness is warranted.
C_caqs_sections.part2_adaptation: Add Dimension 7: Authority Verification. AI verifies: (a) cited authority applies to the domain, (b) specific standard/principle cited matches the question concept, (c) no cross-standard confusion (e.g., COSO IC 2013 cited when COSO ERM 2017 is required), (d) FASB ASC sections match the financial reporting concept.

D_defect_awareness.name: Imprecise wording — variance descriptions
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Specific to Part 1 variance analysis wording patterns (variance equals standard cost). Part 2 has different terminology traps. The pattern-finding methodology carries forward, but the specific regex is not reusable.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Create P2-specific imprecise-wording scan for P2 formula descriptions (e.g., 'NPV equals IRR' confusion, DOL vs DFL conflation).

D_defect_awareness.name: Explanation consistency with correct answer
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Clean in P1. The ExplanationConsistencyValidator pattern is superseded by Rules 2, 6, and 10 in the governance guard. For P2, enforcement is through governance guard rules, not a separate defect tracker.

D_defect_awareness.name: Absolute language in choices ('always', 'never', 'only')
D_defect_awareness.rationale: This defect class produced 958 hits in P1. However, it is a content-authoring quality issue, not a structural governance rule. For P2, enforce through CAQS §6 (Psychometric Standards) and §4 (Language Rules) rather than tracking as a distinct defect ID. The AbsoluteLanguageValidator is reusable but the defect tracking is folded into CAQS compliance.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Carry forward the AbsoluteLanguageValidator. Flag 'always' and 'never' as errors (as P1 did). Enforce at content-authoring quality gate (G4 Instructional Review) rather than defect library.

D_defect_awareness.name: Vague qualifiers ('usually', 'normally', 'generally')
D_defect_awareness.rationale: 410 flagged instances in P1. Same rationale as DL-003: fold into CAQS §4 enforcement rather than separate defect tracking.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Carry forward AmbiguityValidator. Enforce at G4 Instructional Review gate.

D_defect_awareness.name: Distractor similarity — Jaccard overlap >70%
D_defect_awareness.rationale: High recurrence risk for P2 template-based authoring. 450 warnings in P1, highest concentration in Pack E. For P2, upgrade from warning-only to structural blocking for 100% identical distractors (placeholder quality). Keep as tracked defect class because the risk is significant and the validator is reusable.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Upgrade: 100% identical distractors → BLOCK (cannot certify). >70% similarity distractor-distractor → WARN. Carry forward DistractorSimilarityValidator. Target: each distractor tests a distinct P2-specific misconception.

D_defect_awareness.name: Template boilerplate distractor explanations
D_defect_awareness.rationale: This is the single highest-volume defect class in P1 (2,587 occurrences across 882 QIDs). For P2, detected by governance guard Rule 6 (empty distractor slots) and CAQS §4 (explanation uniqueness). The specific boilerplate patterns ('represents a plausible misconception') will differ in P2, but the template risk is identical.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Add to CAQS_P2 §4: BLOCK any ExplanationWrong field containing generic pattern matching (new boilerplate detection for P2 templates). Mandate per-item distractor explanation uniqueness via Jaccard similarity <50% between distractor slots. Target: 0 boilerplate from first write.

D_defect_awareness.name: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] non-empty
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Already listed in P2001 §4 as High recurrence risk. Governance guard Rule 2 provides BLOCK enforcement from Day 1. The single-object architecture eliminates CC-offset false positives. For P2, the DL-008 tracking status is PREVENTED (not RESOLVED — it never occurs).
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Enforced via Rule 2. Add proactive check: certification pipeline must verify zero DL-008 before state transition. Single-object architecture ensures CorrectChoice and ExplanationWrong fields are in the same object.

D_defect_awareness.name: Incorrect authority citation (wrong ASC section)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1 had 483 ASC citations, 12 incorrect. P2 has more diverse authorities (COSO ERM, CAPM, IMA Ethics, SOX, FCPA, Basel III) — higher risk of cross-standard citation errors. The P2 equivalent of citing 'ASC 210' for contingencies is citing 'COSO IC 2013' for ERM or 'ASC 606' for ratio analysis.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Create P2 Authority-to-Topic mapping: for each P2 domain, define the set of valid authorities and their scope. Every ExplanationCorrect must cite an authority that matches the question's domain and topic. Extend ReferenceValidator for P2 authority cross-check. Add to CAQS §1.6 Dimension 7 (Authority Verification).

D_defect_awareness.name: Misassigned choice explanations (EW text describes wrong choice)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Semantic misassignment is inherently a content-authoring defect that cannot be detected by structural rules alone. Single-object architecture reduces but doesn't eliminate risk. P2 needs a semantic verification step in the certification pipeline.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Add to CAQS_P2 certification pipeline: Build-Time AI must verify each ExplanationWrong field semantically describes its assigned choice. Cannot be fully automated; needs AI review per CAQS §1.6. Single-object architecture ensures CC and EW fields are co-located.

D_defect_awareness.name: Section clonal redundancy — template-generated clone waste
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1 had 140 clones (93.3% of Pack C/D Section E) with near-zero pedagogical value. P2's template-based authoring carries the same risk. Single-object architecture doesn't prevent semantic duplication.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Add clone detection to P2 validation pipeline: for each micro-topic, compare stems for Jaccard similarity >90% after removing proper nouns. Flag groups of 5+ items sharing stem skeleton. Require UniqueConceptKey per item (carry forward from P1 metadata).

D_defect_awareness.name: Sibling null guard missing (app.js:1187)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: App.js is forked for P2 with the DL-014 / DL-022 fixes already included. The fix pattern (|| []) should be verified in the P2 fork.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Verify P2 app.js fork includes DL-014 and DL-022 null-guard fixes. Add to P2 app.js test suite.

D_defect_awareness.name: Topic numbering shift (cosmetic metadata offset)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Cosmetic defect with zero learner impact. Caused by template rotation offset. P2's single-object architecture and explicit Topic field format (A.001 instead of A.040) eliminate the rotation-offset pattern.

D_defect_awareness.name: Metadata-block topic-numbering shift (dual-block architecture artifact)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Explicitly eliminated by P2's single-object architecture (P2001 §6). No dual-block means no metadata-content mismatch. This defect class cannot recur in P2.

D_defect_awareness.name: File corruption (backtick-newline artifact from reconstruction script)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Specific to P1 file reconstruction. P2 should never need file reconstruction if backup protocol (§3) is followed. However, file corruption can occur from any script that serializes pack files. The detection pattern (grep for corruption markers) is reusable.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Add file-integrity check to P2 T0 startup: after every script that writes pack files, verify node --check passes, grep for known corruption patterns, and verify QID count matches expected.

D_defect_awareness.name: Missing ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] fields (field absent, not empty)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1 had 352 items with absent EW[CC] fields (Pack E + Pack A Section E). P2's single-object architecture reduces but doesn't eliminate risk — authoring templates may omit fields. Governance guard Rule 10 covers absent distractor fields; no explicit rule covers absent CC-slot fields.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Add field-presence validation to P2 governance guard: if CorrectChoice is present, all four ExplanationWrong fields (A, B, C, D) must be present in the object. The CC-slot can be empty; the distractor slots must be non-empty (Rule 6).

D_defect_awareness.name: Concurrent-write data loss (remediation silently overwritten)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Process defect — applicable to any project with multiple concurrent sessions on the same files. Risk is independent of P1 vs P2 content. If P2 is in its own repo, risk is reduced (no cross-repo writes) but still present within P2 sessions.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Deploy session-coordination mechanism for P2: session_registry.json tracks active sessions per file. File-lock protocol (lockfile per pack before write, release after verification). Per-session T0/Tend re-scan for defect regressions.

D_defect_awareness.name: Brace-matcher lack of string-awareness (validator infrastructure)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1's ExplanationValidator brace-matcher was fixed with string-aware parsing. The P2 fork starts with the fixed validator. No recurrence risk.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Verify P2 validator fork includes string-aware brace-matcher from P1's resolved state. Add string-awareness test to validator test suite.

D_defect_awareness.name: Missing distractor ExplanationWrong fields (absent non-CC slots)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Pack E Section C had 100 items with zero distractor explanations. Governance guard Rule 10 provides BLOCK enforcement from Day 1. For P2, prevent — never allow absent distractor fields.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Enforce via Rule 10. Add to P2 certification pipeline: every item must have all 4 ExplanationWrong fields present and validated before certification. Distractor fields (non-CC) must have ≥50 characters.

D_defect_awareness.name: Null-array crash on corrupted session restore (app.js)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: App.js is forked with the DL-022 fix included. Verify P2 fork carries Insertions 1 and 2.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Verify P2 app.js fork. Add crash-recovery tests to P2 test suite.

D_defect_awareness.name: Case-study exhibit headers missing (Body instead of Headers+Rows)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: 17 P1 exhibits had data in Body instead of canonical Headers+Rows. P2 cases will be authored with the canonical schema from Day 1, but exhibit-authoring errors can still occur.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Add exhibit validation to P2 case creation pipeline: for Type: 'table', Headers and Rows must be non-empty arrays. Add to P2 validateCase() function. No Body-only fallback permitted.

D_defect_awareness.name: Missing question_state field (items outside governance framework)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1 had 150 items without question_state. For P2, question_state is mandatory from Day 1 for every item. The structural risk of missing governance-state fields applies to any new item.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: question_state is a required field in P2 metadata schema (not optional as in P1 §9.1). Default for newly authored items: 'Unprocessed.' Add field-presence check to P2 validator: every item must have question_state.

D_defect_awareness.name: Empty non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Already listed in P2001 §4 as Medium recurrence risk. P1 had 1,005 items with empty distractor slots. Governance guard Rule 6 provides BLOCK enforcement from Day 1. The rotation artifact that caused P1's pattern (5-item template with CC-rotation leaving one slot empty) could recur in P2 template authoring.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Enforce via Rule 6. Add to P2 content-authoring template: after generation, verify all 3 non-CC ExplanationWrong slots are non-empty before saving. Post-generation validation hook.

D_defect_awareness.name: Pattern-3 closing-tag boilerplate ('may misunderstand how the governing standard applies')
D_defect_awareness.rationale: 15 P1 items had boilerplate closing tags appended to otherwise substantive text. P2 template authoring could produce different but similar closing-tag patterns. The detection methodology — grep for generic pedagogical phrases — is reusable.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Add to P2 boilerplate detection: new boilerplate patterns will emerge from P2 templates. Scan for generic phrases appended to specific text during certification review. Enforce CAQS §4.4 EV2: no placeholder phrases.

D_defect_awareness.name: DL-013 remediation tooling regression (short-form rewrite creates empty slots)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1 process defect — remediation tools introduced new defects. For P2, the lesson is: every remediation script must include post-remediation verification. Not about specific code; about process discipline.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Mandate for all P2 remediation scripts: include post-processing verification step. After any batch write, re-scan for the same defect class and confirm count is zero. Also re-scan for related defect classes (e.g., after DL-013 fix, check DL-026).

D_defect_awareness.name: Regex block-scan DL-008 false positives (CC-offset in block-window extraction)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Caused by dual-block architecture where CC precedes QID in the JSON object. P2's single-object architecture eliminates this entirely. All CC and EW fields are in the same object.

D_defect_awareness.name: CorrectChoice answer-key errors (stored CC disagrees with independently derived answer)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Already listed in P2001 §4 as Critical recurrence risk. P1 had 5 Certified items with wrong answers. P2 has more complex calculations (NPV, IRR, WACC, CAPM) — higher risk of arithmetic errors in answer keys. Each item must be independently recalculated before certification.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Mandatory independent recalculation for ALL P2 calculation items before certification (not spot-check — full population). Requires: (a) blind solve — reviewer reads stem without seeing stored answer, (b) documented calculation with formula+substitution+result, (c) comparison to stored Correct value. Auto-fail certification if mismatch. Add to CAQS §1.6 Dimension 3.

D_defect_awareness.name: Difficulty inflation — definition-match items labeled Moderate
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Already listed in P2001 §4 as High recurrence risk. Estimated ~500 P1 items have inflated difficulty. P2's template-based authoring carries the same risk. For P2, difficulty labels must be justified by cognitive demand assessment, not position in rotation group.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Per-item cognitive-level justification required before certification. For any item where stem-CorrectChoice lexical overlap >50% and distractors are definition-level opposites, default to Easy (1) unless distractors require application-level discernment. Add DifficultyCalibrationValidator to P2 validator pipeline.

D_defect_awareness.name: Case bank uniform difficulty — all Moderate, no calibration
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1's 420 case items were all labeled Moderate — statistically implausible. P2's 75 cases (~400 items) must have genuine difficulty calibration from Day 1. Same template risk.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Require difficulty variance across cases: no single difficulty label may account for ≥90% of items in any case pack. Every case item must have a difficulty label justified by cognitive level, calculation complexity, exhibit count, and distractor deceptiveness. Add CaseDifficultyVarianceValidator to P2 validator pipeline.

D_defect_awareness.name: Wave 4 'Pack E' archival discrepancy (naming confusion)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Documentation-only false alarm caused by 'Pack A Section E' vs 'Pack E' naming confusion. P2 uses explicit naming (pack_p2_a.js) that eliminates the ambiguity. Awareness is still valuable.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: P2 naming convention: 'Pack A' = file pack_p2_a.js (Domain A: Financial Statement Analysis). 'Section A' never used as standalone — always 'Pack A' or 'Domain A.' The P2- prefix eliminates P1 confusion.

D_defect_awareness.name: Missing structural fields (CorrectChoice, Stem, ExplanationCorrect absent)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1-E-R33 had three missing structural fields — a template-rotation omission. P2 single-object architecture reduces but doesn't eliminate risk. Every item must pass structural completeness validation before certification.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Add structural-completeness validation to P2 certification pipeline: every item must have QuestionID, Part, Section, Topic, Stem, Choices.{A,B,C,D}, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrong{A,B,C,D} (all 4 present), Difficulty, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel, question_state, Part2OnlyFlag. Missing any required field → BLOCK certification.

D_defect_awareness.name: Governance guard DL-026 coverage gap (Certified items with empty distractor slots)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1 governance guard lacked DL-026 enforcement at certification time, allowing 39 Certified items into the learner pool with empty distractor explanations. For P2, the governance guard must include ALL structural rules from Day 1 — Rules 2, 6, 10 must all be active before any certification.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Proactive governance design: all 10 rules active before first content write. No gap retrofilling. Governance guard test suite must verify every rule before production. P2 certification pipeline checklist includes governance guard compliance verification.

D_defect_awareness.name: Pipeline artifact reuse gap (tools produce divergent BLOCKED counts)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: P1's pipeline tools independently re-scanned source files with different regexes, producing divergent counts. P2 should connect pipeline stages via artifact consumption rather than independent re-scanning.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: P2 pipeline design: upstream stages produce stable artifacts consumed by downstream stages. Readiness scorer produces classification artifact; certifier consumes it. Single source of truth per stage. Avoids regex-divergence defects.

D_defect_awareness.name: Choice binary lead-in polarity mismatch ('No' / 'Yes' contradicted by conclusion)
D_defect_awareness.rationale: Language-level defect. Governance guard Rule 9 enforces from Day 1. One instance found in P1 (P1-B-040). P2 may produce similar Yes/No choice patterns.
D_defect_awareness.part2_adaptation: Enforce via Rule 9. Add to P2 full-pool scan after each certification wave. Pattern detection regex may need P2-specific expansion for P2 language patterns.

E_constitution_rules.name: AI SHALL NOT — Immutable Prohibitions (13 rules)
E_constitution_rules.rationale: All 13 immutable prohibitions are content-independent: delete questions, delete explanations, delete case studies, reuse IDs, renumber questions, invent accounting standards, invent formulas, guess when uncertain, change answers without justification, change JavaScript during accounting review, modify scoring without review, modify timers during content review, alter schema definitions, break backward compatibility.

E_constitution_rules.name: AI SHALL — Positive Obligations (7 rules)
E_constitution_rules.rationale: All seven positive obligations are content-independent: solve every question independently, review exhibits before reviewing answers, validate formulas, report confidence, explain every correction, preserve formatting, maintain question IDs, maintain metadata, document assumptions.

E_constitution_rules.name: AI Persona Roles (8 simultaneous roles)
E_constitution_rules.rationale: All eight AI persona roles apply to P2: Senior Management Accountant (P2 = financial analysis, corporate finance focus), CMA Examination Editor, Accounting Instructor, Software Architect, JavaScript Developer, Quality Assurance Engineer, Technical Writer, Psychometric Reviewer.
E_constitution_rules.part2_adaptation: The Senior Management Accountant role shifts from Part 1 focus (financial accounting, cost management, controls) to Part 2 focus (ratio analysis, corporate finance, decision analysis, investment decisions, ERM, ethics).

E_constitution_rules.name: Primary Responsibilities (5 responsibilities)
E_constitution_rules.rationale: All five responsibilities (protect accounting accuracy, examination quality, software stability, educational value, maintainability) apply identically to P2.

E_constitution_rules.name: Decision Hierarchy (6-tier priority)
E_constitution_rules.rationale: The six-tier decision hierarchy (Accounting correctness → Examination integrity → Educational value → Code stability → User experience → Convenience) is content-independent.

E_constitution_rules.name: Source Hierarchy (5 tiers of authoritative sources)
E_constitution_rules.rationale: The five-tier source hierarchy structure carries forward, but the specific authoritative sources change for Part 2. P2 has different Tier 1-3 sources.
E_constitution_rules.part2_adaptation: Tier 1: IMA CMA Part 2 CSO, COSO ERM (2017), IMA Statement of Ethical Professional Practice. Tier 2: FASB ASC (ratio-related standards), CAPM (Sharpe-Lintner 1964), Modigliani-Miller propositions. Tier 3: Established corporate finance textbooks (Brealey-Myers, Ross-Westerfield-Jaffe). Tier 4: CFA Institute publications, professional finance publications. Tier 5: General educational websites.

E_constitution_rules.name: Repository Philosophy — Every file exists for a single purpose
E_constitution_rules.rationale: Universal software engineering principle. File purposing is content-independent.

E_constitution_rules.name: Root Directory Permitted Files
E_constitution_rules.rationale: The permitted root files list changes entirely for P2. Structure is identical; filenames differ.
E_constitution_rules.part2_adaptation: Permitted P2 root files: index_updated.html, app.js, styles.css, pack_p2_a.js through pack_p2_e.js, case_pack_p2_1.js through case_pack_p2_3.js, package.json, package-lock.json, opencode.json, VERSION.

E_constitution_rules.name: Subfolder Organization
E_constitution_rules.rationale: The same subfolder structure (backups/, scripts/, reports/, knowledge/, ai/, foundation/, review/, .opencode/) applies to P2. Each subfolder serves the same purpose.

E_constitution_rules.name: Enforcement — Automated root directory cleanliness validation
E_constitution_rules.rationale: Universal hygiene enforcement. Before any release/commit: all backups in backups/, all scripts in scripts/, all reports in reports/. P2 uses same enforcement.

E_constitution_rules.name: Prohibited Root-Level Files
E_constitution_rules.rationale: The prohibition list carries forward but with P2-specific filenames. Backup patterns, ad-hoc scripts, temp files, and audit reports prohibited in root. May coaching layer files (if forked) need explicit exception.
E_constitution_rules.part2_adaptation: Extend prohibition to P2-specific patterns: pack_p2_*.bak, audit_report_p2_*.md, temp_p2_*.txt. If May coaching layer is forked, may-core-p2.js and may-learner-state-p2.js require explicit authorized-runtime-exception entries.

E_constitution_rules.name: Guiding Principle — Professional software product first, AI project second
E_constitution_rules.rationale: Universal guiding principle. Quality is defined by standards, not AI.

F_session_startup.name: Read SESSION_STATUS for open risks and blocked files
F_session_startup.rationale: The startup protocol step applies to P2, but the SESSION_STATUS file is P2-specific: reports/session_status/SESSION_STATUS_P2_YYYY-MM-DD.md. P2 has its own open risks and blocked files.
F_session_startup.part2_adaptation: Update file path to P2 session status. Note: P2 starts with a clean slate — initial SESSION_STATUS will document setup risks, not remediation backlog.

F_session_startup.name: Read REVISION_HISTORY for most recent certification state
F_session_startup.rationale: Same step, P2-specific file: knowledge/REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md. P2 starts with an empty revision history.
F_session_startup.part2_adaptation: Update file path to knowledge/REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md. Initial state: empty.

F_session_startup.name: Direct grep for Certified count — raw pack files are authoritative
F_session_startup.rationale: Same methodology (direct grep, raw files authoritative) but P2-specific files and patterns. No derived registries consumed.
F_session_startup.part2_adaptation: Grep pattern: Select-String -Path pack_p2_*.js -Pattern '"question_state": "Certified"' | Measure-Object. Add P2-specific: also grep Part2OnlyFlag presence. Add case packs to the scan: case_pack_p2_*.js.

F_session_startup.name: Cross-registry reconciliation — compare raw grep to CURRENT_BASELINES and MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY
F_session_startup.rationale: Same reconciliation methodology, P2-specific registries: CURRENT_BASELINES_P2.md §2 (Certified Pool), MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY_P2.md (Certified column). Any divergence >0 → halt and reconcile from raw source files.
F_session_startup.part2_adaptation: Update file references to P2 equivalents. Add P2-specific reconciliation: verify Part2OnlyFlag count matches Certified count (every Certified P2 item must have Part2OnlyFlag=true).

F_session_startup.name: Governance-critical hash verification — verify SHA-256 hashes against CURRENT_BASELINES
F_session_startup.rationale: Hash verification methodology is identical. P2 baselines are in CURRENT_BASELINES_P2.md §5. Any unexpected change → halt all certification operations.
F_session_startup.part2_adaptation: P2 governance-critical files include: .opencode/plugins/governance-guard.js (forked), scripts/test_governance_guard_p2.js, scripts/validators/ExplanationValidator.js (forked, string-aware), scripts/build_master_registry_p2.js.

F_session_startup.name: Registry staleness check — flag derived registry >24 hours behind raw-file Certified count
F_session_startup.rationale: Same staleness check methodology, P2-specific registries. Do not consume stale registries.
F_session_startup.part2_adaptation: Apply to MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY_P2.md and CURRENT_BASELINES_P2.md. In early P2 development, registries will be frequently regenerated — staleness threshold may be shorter (e.g., 12 hours during active authoring).

F_session_startup.name: Cross-check open remediation proposals against current state in source files
F_session_startup.rationale: Universal startup discipline. P2 initially has no open remediation proposals. The check becomes relevant as remediation activity begins.
F_session_startup.part2_adaptation: P2-specific: check reports/remediation/ directory for open proposals. Verify each proposal's claimed counts against current raw-file state.

G_new_part2_only.name: Part2OnlyFlag Mandatory Enforcement
G_new_part2_only.rationale: Every P2 item must carry Part2OnlyFlag: true to prevent cross-contamination with Part 1 content. This flag is unique to Part 2 — Part 1 has no equivalent. It serves as both a structural marker and a verification gate: items without this flag are blocked from both the P1 and P2 certification pipelines.
G_new_part2_only.part2_adaptation: Add to P2 governance guard as Rule 11 (or standalone validator): every item in pack_p2_*.js must have Part2OnlyFlag field. Value must be true. Items with Part2OnlyFlag: false or absent → BLOCK certification. Full-pool scan verifies 100% presence.

G_new_part2_only.name: Cross-Part Collision Detection — QID prefix verification
G_new_part2_only.rationale: If P2 is in a separate repo (recommended by P2001 §6), cross-contamination is structurally prevented. If co-located, every P2 item must use the P2- prefix to prevent collision with P1- QIDs. The validator must reject any item with a P1- QID in a P2 pack file and vice versa.
G_new_part2_only.part2_adaptation: Add to P2 validator: QID prefix check. pack_p2_*.js items must have QIDs matching /^P2-[A-F]-\d{3}$/. Case items must match /^CBQ2\d*-[A-F]\d*-Q\d+$/. Flag any item with P1- prefix or CBQ prefix (without '2').

G_new_part2_only.name: Formula Verification — Independent Recalculation Protocol for 40+ P2 Formulas
G_new_part2_only.rationale: Part 2 has 40+ formulas (NPV, IRR, WACC, CAPM, DuPont, DOL, DFL, EOQ, breakeven, transfer pricing, expected value, etc.) — significantly more complex than Part 1's ~30 formulas. Many P2 formulas involve iterative calculation (IRR), multi-component inputs (WACC), or domain-specific conventions (MACRS). A dedicated formula verification protocol is needed beyond CAQS §5.
G_new_part2_only.part2_adaptation: Create FORMULA_MASTER_P2.md with all 40+ formulas, each with: (a) canonical formula notation, (b) variable definitions, (c) P2 domain, (d) acceptable tolerance, (e) common calculation errors. Add FormulaVerificationValidator to P2 pipeline: for each calculation item, verify (a) formula matches FORMULA_MASTER_P2.md canonical form, (b) substituted values trace to stem/exhibit data, (c) arithmetic result reconciles within tolerance, (d) rounding applied at correct step.

G_new_part2_only.name: Domain-Specific Calculation Tolerance Standards
G_new_part2_only.rationale: P2 calculations have domain-specific precision requirements: NPV to nearest dollar, IRR to 2 decimal places (XX.XX%), WACC to 2 decimal places, bond prices to 3 decimal places, betas to 2 decimal places, ratios to 2 decimal places, EPS to 2 decimal places. P1 used uniform rounding rules; P2 needs per-domain tolerances.
G_new_part2_only.part2_adaptation: Extend CAQS_P2 §5.2 with P2-specific rounding table: Domain A (ratios) → 2 decimal places, Domain B (WACC, CAPM, bond) → 2-3 decimal places, Domain C (CVP, breakeven) → whole units/dollars, Domain D (risk scores) → 2 decimal places, Domain E (NPV, IRR, payback) → dollar/2 decimal places, Domain F (no calculations). Enforce tolerance at validation.

G_new_part2_only.name: Authority Verification — P2-Specific Authority-to-Topic Mapping
G_new_part2_only.rationale: Part 2 has 7+ distinct authoritative frameworks (COSO ERM 2017, CAPM, IMA Ethics, SOX, FCPA, Modigliani-Miller, Basel III, MACRS/IRS Pub 946, FASB ASC for ratios). Citing the wrong authority is a correctness defect. P1 had DL-009 (12 wrong ASC citations); P2 has more authorities = higher risk.
G_new_part2_only.part2_adaptation: Create AUTHORITY_TO_TOPIC_MAP_P2.md: for each P2 domain and LOS, define the set of valid authorities and their scope. Extend CAQS_P2 §1.6 Dimension 7 (Authority Verification): AI verifies (a) cited authority is in the valid set for the item's domain, (b) specific principle/standard cited matches the question concept, (c) no COSO IC (2013) cited where COSO ERM (2017) is required, (d) no ASC 606 (revenue) cited in a Domain B corporate finance question. Enforce at certification gate.

G_new_part2_only.name: Ethics Distractor Quality Standard — No False Ethics Violations
G_new_part2_only.rationale: Domain F (Professional Ethics) is unique to Part 2 — Part 1 has no standalone ethics domain. Ethics distractors must not fabricate false ethical violations. A distractor claiming 'violates IMA Competence standard' for a reasonable professional action is a correctness defect. Every ethics distractor must reference a genuine, documented ethical principle.
G_new_part2_only.part2_adaptation: Add to CAQS_P2 §4 for Domain F items: every ExplanationWrong field in ethics items must cite the specific IMA standard being misapplied (Competence, Confidentiality, Integrity, Credibility) or the specific ethical principle being confused. No generic 'this violates ethics' placeholder. Distractors must reflect genuine ethical dilemmas from IMA Ethics guidance, not artificial 'gotchas.' Add EthicsDistractorValidator.

G_new_part2_only.name: ERM Component Validation — COSO ERM 2017 Component Accuracy
G_new_part2_only.rationale: Domain D (Risk Management) uses COSO ERM 2017 with 5 components and 20 principles. P1 used COSO IC 2013 (completely different framework). Questions must cite the correct ERM component (Governance & Culture, Strategy & Objective-Setting, Performance, Review & Revision, Information/Communication & Reporting) — not the IC components (Control Environment, Risk Assessment, Control Activities, Information & Communication, Monitoring). Cross-framework confusion is a known P1 defect pattern (DL-009) that would recur in P2.
G_new_part2_only.part2_adaptation: Add ERM component validation: every Domain D item citing COSO must reference the correct ERM 2017 component, not the IC 2013 component. Create COSO_CROSS_REFERENCE_P2.md mapping IC components to ERM components. Add to CAQS_P2 §1.6 Authority Verification dimension: flag any Domain D item citing 'Control Environment,' 'Control Activities,' 'Monitoring Activities' as IC leakage.

G_new_part2_only.name: Capital Budgeting Method Validation — Mutual Exclusivity and Ranking Rules
G_new_part2_only.rationale: Domain E (Investment Decisions) tests capital budgeting methods (NPV, IRR, payback, PI, ARR). Several have known ranking conflicts: NPV and IRR can rank mutually exclusive projects differently due to scale and timing differences. Questions testing these conflicts must get the hierarchy correct (NPV is theoretically superior to IRR for mutually exclusive projects). Incorrect ranking order in answer keys is a correctness defect.
G_new_part2_only.part2_adaptation: Add to Domain E certification criteria: for questions testing capital budgeting ranking, verify (a) NPV is correctly identified as the theoretically superior method, (b) IRR scale/timing conflicts are correctly resolved, (c) payback period is correctly identified as a liquidity measure (not profitability), (d) PI is correctly used for capital rationing. Add CapitalBudgetingMethodValidator.

appendix.p2_governance_gap_coverage: All Part 1 governance guard rules (1-10), AGENTS.md sections (1-13), CAQS quality standards (§1-§15), and Constitution rules (§7-§12) have been classified for Part 2. 37 elements carry forward unchanged, 47 require modification (domain references, file paths, authority updates), 8 P1-specific or subsumed defects are retired, and 9 new elements are added (8 governance rules/standards + 1 verification dimension). All predicted governance gaps from P2001 §4 are addressed.
